samples.question: Three colored triangles are drawn on a light panel: one red, one blue, one green, each in its own horizontal column so they do not overlap. Measure each triangle's PERIMETER, defined as the sum of the lengths of its three sides, where each side length is the straight-line distance between two of the triangle's corners. Which colored triangle has the LARGEST perimeter (the greatest total outline length)? Answer with only the color: red, blue, or green. (selection by greatest three-sided sum).
